Model integration supports standard provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, local LLMs) with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool discovery and execution.

Objective: Build an extensible terminal-native agent workspace that allows multiple independent terminal sessions and TUI tools to share context, coordinate agent actions, and communicate seamlessly via a unified IPC daemon.
Project: OS/TUI/model agnostic workspace enabling native TUI workflows and cross-session agent communication.
Safety & Constraints: Tool execution approval gates: interactive confirmation prompts for destructive shell or filesystem actions.
Local-first data privacy: conversation context and session logs never leave the local machine except when calling configured LLM APIs.
Graceful socket cleanup and lock handling to prevent stale daemon instances.
User Experience: Users launch the daemon or let it auto-spawn on first CLI/TUI invocation.
Any terminal window can send prompts, pipe command output, or listen to agent events via simple CLI commands or dedicated TUI views.
Agents can notify other sessions when background tasks complete or request user confirmation before tool execution.
